signal.basis: b_t = log(close_leg_a_t) - log(close_leg_b_t) on exact common M5 timestamps
signal.rolling_center_scale: using completed bars through t, center = rolling median basis over lookback_bars; scale = 1.4826 * rolling median absolute deviation from that rolling median over the same lookback; require scale>0
signal.entry_signal: z_t=(b_t-center_t)/scale_t; first non-overlapping completed bar with abs(z_t)>=entry_abs_z; if z>0 short leg A/long leg B, if z<0 long A/short B
signal.target_exit: freeze center_t at signal; after entry, when completed close-basis crosses the frozen center, exit both legs at next exact common M5 open
signal.failure_exit: freeze initial absolute basis deviation d0=abs(b_t-center_t); if completed close-basis moves to >=2.0*d0 away from frozen center in the adverse direction, exit both legs at next exact common M5 open
signal.time_exit: if neither target nor failure triggers, exit both legs at next exact common open after maximum_hold_bars completed bars
signal.gross_return_on_total_gross_notional: equal 50/50 notional legs; pair bps = 0.5 * (-sign(z_signal)*log(A_exit/A_entry) + sign(z_signal)*log(B_exit/B_entry)) * 10000
signal.overlap_policy: one open pair position per pair x cell; later signals ignored until exit
signal.missing_or_ambiguous: right-censor fail-closed; exact common timestamps only; no interpolation, lead-lag shifting, stale-leg repair, or synthetic basis

multiplicity.family: all 36 frozen pair x lookback x z x hold cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: All 36 cells remain family members. Only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites (>=40 completed events, >=30 dates, >=20 ISO weeks, retention>=0.90) generate finite max-T statistics; others receive p=1.

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one-step grid adjacency within same deterministic pair
